diagnosticConclusion: The locator.evaluate callback in chooseOption referenced normalize, which was not defined in the browser page context. The 34 recorded actions completed before the failing callback, including APPEND input setup and output label entry; the error occurred outside an action wrapper. No product fix is demonstrated, and the full APPEND lifecycle remains open.
